solutions.name: Global Fabric
solutions.desc: Instant multi-service, multi-cloud Network-as-a-Service for sites, clouds, apps, and partners.
solutions.lede: One NaaS platform instead of a different network in every region.
solutions.why: Expand, multi-cloud, and AI workloads need connectivity that provisions on demand and peers into SSE clouds.

solutions.name: Direct Internet Access
solutions.desc: Dedicated internet, Global Fabric Business Internet, and Internet Connect Reach.
solutions.lede: Uncontended access for cloud, voice, and the WAN overlay.
solutions.why: SaaS, collaboration, and SD-WAN need a dedicated path, including markets beyond BT PoPs.

solutions.name: Managed SD-WAN and SASE
solutions.desc: Managed SD-WAN plus SSE from Cisco, Fortinet, Netskope, or Zscaler.
solutions.lede: The WAN overlay and the security edge as one managed SASE service.
solutions.why: Branches, users, and SaaS need one overlay and a chosen SSE, peered through Global Fabric.

solutions.name: Global Voice
solutions.desc: Global SIP, inbound contact, and UC Edge on one voice platform.
solutions.lede: Carrier voice under Webex, Teams, Zoom, and contact centre.
solutions.why: International calling and UC migration fail when every country is a different voice estate.

solutions.name: Cisco collaboration
solutions.desc: Webex Calling, Webex Meetings, One Cloud Cisco, and the Cisco Collaboration proposition.
solutions.lede: Cisco calling and meetings, in Cisco’s cloud or hosted by BT.
solutions.why: Customers who standardised on Cisco need a global voice layer and a hosted option, not another stack.

solutions.name: Ops Fabric
solutions.desc: AI-powered managed operations across connectivity, overlay, security, voice, and digital experience.
solutions.lede: One operating model for the platforms you just connected.
solutions.why: Global Fabric, Global Voice, and SASE still need observability, automation, and experts.
